alex_k: Drafting a short plan for cost observability — propose we sample high-volume token streams and add cache-savings attribution per-route. TL;DR: cut telemetry volume but keep unit-econ signals intact. Looking for quick feedback.

maya: SG. Quick Q — how do we attribute cache wins? do we credit the route that triggered the cache, or split credits among recent routes that primed the prefix?

liam: My vote: lineage-based credits if we can trace the exact request that seeded the cache. Otherwise a fallback split by recent TTL window (e.g., last 30m weight by requests). Keeps incentives tight.

sana: Also: we should report per-model effective token-cost after applied quantization/profiles. Right now raw token counts + model name are misleading. Need a derived metric like `effective_unit_cost` (cost_per_token * quant_factor).

carla: UX note: dashboard lines: model SKU | quant profile | avg token cost | cache credits (negative) | net token cost. Users should be able to toggle "include cache credits". Keep the default ON for finance view.

alex_k: Drafted a tiny proto SQL for sampling config and initial telemetry join: ```-- sampling config
SELECT route_id, model_sku, avg(token_count) as avg_tok, sample_rate
FROM telemetry_config
WHERE env = 'prod'
GROUP BY route_id, model_sku
``` Thinking sample_rate = f(token_bucket, p50_latency). We downsample high-token tails more.

maya: +1 sample by token_bucket and route weight. Note: embeddings deserve higher sampling because even small token counts have high per-call unit cost; treat them as separate class.

liam: On routing: if we start routing a % of traffic to cheaper model variants during rollouts, the rollout UI must surface the cost delta per cohort (A/B) so PMs can balance quality vs cost. Add a small table with projected monthly savings at current traffic.

sana: ops-bot: can we land a nightly job that computes per-route cache-credit allocations and writes to `cost_ledger`? That ledger will be the source of truth for dashboard credits.

ops-bot: Scheduled task created: `cost-alloc-runner v0.2` will run nightly at 02:00 UTC and emit `cost_ledger` rows with fields: event_ts, route_id, model_sku, cache_credit_tokens, cache_credit_usd. :robot_face:

carla: Another UX ask: quotas panel should show projected burn-rate if traffic stays the same + a burnout alarm for reserved capacity thresholds. That helps teams know when to request Dedicated capacity.

alex_k: Nice — I'll update the PR with sampling params, the prototype SQL, and a mock dashboard wireframe. Assigning @maya to own cache-credit logic and @liam to add routing rollout exposure in the UI. Will ping this thread when the PR is ready. :thumbsup:
